In this video I walk you through a complete self-hosted NetBird setup from scratch. We're talking a VPS install with Caddy handling TLS, Pocket ID as a self-hosted OIDC provider so you can use passkeys, the new reverse proxy feature to publicly expose services without touching your home router, high availability routing peers for homelab access, and access control policies you can actually use for family or team setups.

📖 RESOURCES
my NetBird Setup: https://bit.ly/homelab-netbird
NetBird Docs: https://bit.ly/selfhost-netbird
Hostinger: https://hostinger.com/techhut10

By the end you'll have a solid foundation for remote access to your homelab from anywhere in the world, with no open ports at home.
